title: Codex hooks install with verified loading, trust diagnostics and real wake delivery
acceptance: Why. Captain explicitly orders fixing Codex hooks on 2026-10-01; Claude works. Local codex-cli 0.159.3 features list shows hooks stable true; user config features.hooks true; project trust is trusted. Repo .codex/hooks.json exists with Stop/UserPromptSubmit commands, but no SessionStart registration. Existing installer bin/lib/fm_hooks.py only merges hook JSON. A real board answer D-firstmate-workflow-T162-1 at 15:40:49Z entered wake queue, but watcher only took it at 15:49:03Z; no automatic conversational delivery was verified. Its own spec must be committed.

Use official current https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/hooks and installed Codex capability/schema evidence. Correct project-local installation for supported CLI/app-server clients: real hook source loading, current event names/output schema, feature enablement and exact-definition hook trust are distinct checks. Do not infer installation success from file existence, project trust or binary strings. Report managed-policy refusal and unsupported surface honestly. Preserve custom hooks/config, installation/uninstallation idempotence and paths with spaces; never commit local user configuration or credentials.

Implement diagnostics and actionable supported trust/reload instructions: official docs require reviewing/trusting exact non-managed hook definitions via /hooks; changed hashes require re-review. Do not use dangerously-bypass-hook-trust, fabricate trust records, impersonate operator trust or overwrite global settings to force success. If live operator trust or restart is needed, give firstmate a concrete minimal final step after implementation, not an unsupported workaround. Scope local install to this repo and firstmate-owned hooks; preserve Claude/Cursor behavior.

Ensure session-start/resume and user-turn hook integration actually arms/reconnects one kernel-owned watcher and injects pending context. Stop integration must use supported Codex stop protocol and distinguish already active stop hook, crew/away sessions, delivery versus writer/ack bookkeeping, timeout/error and no pending work. Never claim idle push wake unless live evidence proves that exact harness supports it. No raw vendor launcher, captain-pane input injection, handwritten monitor, polling loop or orphan watcher.

Add feature-owned realistic regression coverage for install/uninstall and custom-hook preservation, disabled features, untrusted/changed trust status, unsupported client and event/output wiring, startup/resume, Stop continuation/context, duplicate firing/single watcher and queued decision delivered once with recoverable failures. Workers author but do not run suites. Coordinate shared fm_watch/fm_lifeline changes without editing running snapshots; no unrelated production refactor.

Firstmate validates candidate via CI/gates and a real Codex hook smoke in an isolated disposable fixture using supported loading/trust, recording version, actual loaded hook source, fired event, decision wake identity, model-visible context or stop continuation and owner cleanup. A queue entry or acknowledged file alone is not delivery evidence. Record separately current conversation hot-reload/restart limits and Claude regression evidence. If trust UI/restart needs the captain, complete reviewable repair first and identify the exact missing action; do not claim fully repaired before real events run.
